columns.validationmsg: "Item Flat Disc should be greater than zero"
columns.name: itemflatdisc

columns.validationmsg: 'Sale Price should be greater than zero'
columns.name: saleprice

columns.validationmsg: 'Special Rate should be greater than zero'
columns.name: specialrate

table.retrieve:
SELECT 
	item.customicode, 
	itemname= item.name, 
	currlistrow = 0,
	stock     = 0.0000, 
	totalstock= 0.0000, 
	assgcode  = 1, 
	qtysale=item.saleqty,
	bonus=item.bonusqty,
	updatesaleprice = 'N',
	quotationdetail.quotationcode,   
	quotationdetail.icode,   
	quotationdetail.itemflatdisc,
	quotationdetail.IDENTITYCOL,
	quotationdetail.itemdescription,
	quotationdetail.gcode,
	quotationdetail.packunits,
	quotationdetail.saleprice,
	quotationdetail.specialrate,
	quotationdetail.porate,
	quotationdetail.podiscperc,
	quotationdetail.salestax,  
	quotationdetail.bonusqty,
	quotationdetail.RemoteNetSaleQty,
	quotationdetail.RemoteStock,
	quotationdetail.RefNo,
	rpp = item.recentpurprice / CASE WHEN (SELECT MAX(QuotationHeader.loosepack) FROM QuotationHeader WHERE QuotationHeader.QuotationCode = :ar_QuotationCode ) = 1 THEN CASE WHEN item.packunits > 1 THEN item.packunits ELSE 1 END ELSE 1 END,
	avgprice = ISNULL(item.avgprice, 0),
	Manufacturer=(SELECT M.Name FROM Manufacturer M WHERE Item.Manfcode = M.Manfcode),
	unitsalestax=quotationdetail.unitsalestax,
	GSTPerc=quotationdetail.GSTPErc,
	quotationdetail.qty,
	quotationdetail.color,
	quotationdetail.claimablediscperc,
	quotationdetail.discperc
FROM 
	quotationdetail,   
	item 
WHERE 
	( dbo.quotationdetail.quotationcode = :ar_QuotationCode )    AND
	( quotationdetail.icode = item.icode )
order by 
	rowid

objects.name: c_detaildwtotal
objects.expression: sum((  ( looseqty *  (saleprice -  itemflatdisc ))   ) *  ( 1-  (  discperc  *  .01 )  )  for all)

objects.name: c_sumgstval
objects.expression: Sum ( Round(( c_itemtotal * gstperc * 0.01),2)  for all )
